descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Cultural Heritage Portrait for MARA ENKAI AW26 Maasai heritage tribute (created in consultation with Maasai cultural advisors under protocols of respectful depiction). Subject: a Maasai warrior 28, of Il-Kisongo Kenyan lineage, close-shaven head, high cheekbones, quiet-alert bearing; Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush across cheekbones and brow in warm golden hour. Wardrobe: a shuka-crimson #A82028 hand-woven checkered shuka cloth draped across the body and over one shoulder, a secondary shuka sash tied at the waist, stacked beadwork-white #F0EADC and beadwork-cobalt #1E4AA8 and vermillion enkarewa collar necklaces in wide concentric discs (traditional Maasai loose-thread beading), stacked bead bracelets and anklets, coiled beaded ear ornaments distending the earlobe respectfully, a bead-wrapped rungu carried in one hand. Setting: open Kenyan savanna at golden hour, a single savanna-acacia-gold #B88E4E umbrella acacia silhouette, golden ochre grass carrying warm dust, Mara escarpment in the far distance. Composition: Rule of Thirds face 44% x 42% y, hero vertical, Eye-Level 0°, body 3/4 turned, gaze steady and self-possessed. Camera: Canon R5 · 85mm f/2.0 · 1/400s · ISO 100. Lighting: Golden Hour Backlight Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — low east-african sun camera-right-back 10° elevation 40m (key rim warming skin and beadwork), 4×4ft gold bounce camera-left 1.5m (fill on face), 1×3ft strip rim camera-back 30° grazing enkarewa beaded collar (rim highlighting beadwork facets), 4×4ft black flag below left to anchor shuka shadow. Material physics: hand-woven checkered shuka cotton warp-faced weave, loose-thread glass-bead micro-facet refraction, leather rungu matte, acacia silhouette airy. Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 emulation grain 6 +0.2 EV. Palette: shuka-crimson 26%, beadwork-white 14%, beadwork-cobalt 14%, savanna-acacia-gold 22%, skin-rich-warm 24%. References: Nick Brandt East Africa, Jimmy Nelson Before They Pass Away, National Geographic Maasai. Exclude: harsh flash, plastic skin, AI hallucination artifacts, cropped extremities, muddy shadows.
